explication: ChatJS is an EVE-native AI chat application and reusable app foundation. A user enters through the chat workspace, submits a prompt, and sees a durable conversation response; EVE owns transcript execution and recovery, while ChatJS provides authenticated access, metadata, tools, files, and billing evidence. The graph also preserves documented product branches—projects, sharing, search, attachments, MCP, and model/tool integrations. Source excerpts are limited, so uncertain runtime wiring is omitted or marked unverified rather than inferred from names.
